sourceSnapshot.boundary: 1318parent engineering inputs, four new test sources, only optional reusable CDP guide changed. Production/P/native/deps/config/version unchanged. Actual parent-package82runtime hash verified, same original sixsmokes reused after73parent artifacts verified. No rebuild/release.

coverage.U: Existing19PptxBuffer tests plus6draft envelope cases retain latest raw targets, composition, queued mutation/old save acknowledgement and autosave freeze/retry boundaries. Not counted as new formal cases or real system IME.
coverage.I: Two new production FileBuffer/PptxBuffer + FileService/actual r90 Worker/native FS cases: temporary parent0555 produces genuine permission-denied receipt without modifying source file revision; autosave500ms fails, later input checkpoint stays durable after3000ms with no extra write, close retry fails and retains live model/source, explicit retry saves newest and close succeeds. Invalid chart1, persists raw draft, refuses close before any write, correction15/27 saves. Three other actual native I regressions serialize queued500ms writes and XLSX/PPTX same-op replay, plus23real Worker/service/storage-adapter cases. Total53 all enabled no skip.
coverage.A: Normal r90, four full light/dark scenarios. Real first native write failure shown, continuing latest notes stays dirty/durable with autosave frozen, real failed-close queue triggers unsaved dialog without closing/overwriting, explicit file-menu retry persists latest notes, closes/reopens latest. Invalid chartraw1, rejects flush and blocks close with error and zero source writes, correction15,27 and explicit menu save cleanly close. Independent Python active-slide/chart relationship readback checks saved15/27; retained orphan original chart3/4 is intentionally not treated as active. Notes change only targeted part, chart closure changes only declared slide/relations/type parts plus added chart/workbook; all other original part hashes preserved. Eight original save calls, fourgenuine failed receipts plusfoursuccess; original input/result hashes and four fault sourcehashes unchanged, directory modes restored. AllsixnativePptxthreads exit, original watch frames released unchanged and sevenRPC handlers restored, zero rendererexceptions, normalApp0/null.
coverage.scheduleInterpretation: R07.11 explicitly freezes automatic writes after failure. Later scheduling continues durable recovery; explicit save/close-save retries resume the serialized queue. No claim that merely typing immediately resumes infinite automatic writes.

failureHistory.nativeFirst: First fixture chmodded source itself, which changes ctime: genuine revision guard rejected changed identity before intended write IO. Also helper mocked closeDocument synchronously (dispose .catch failed) and decoded current pending envelope as object instead of array. Corrected only new tests: deny source parent0555, async close adapter and exact array assertion. First19pass/2fail kept, final53pass.
failureHistory.appFirst: 20s waiting assertion expired while actual shared native layout/table-layout jobs delayed save. Original handler had entered with parent0555 but had not completed; App cleanup ended it before handler finally. Explicit own-directory0755 restoration recorded; reusable observer now also restores any in-flight fault modes before process cleanup. No partial original handler result counted as pass.
failureHistory.appSecond: Original native first Permission denied verified, then close UI10s wait expired while newer layout/save queue ran. Changed test deadlines to90s, actual states remain mandatory; no production timeout or queue changes.
failureHistory.appThird: One full write case passed; corrected chart saved and UI clean, but independent reader incorrectly hardcoded original chart1.xml and saw retained orphan3/4. Read-only corrected oracle follows active slide rIdWillYouChart1→willyou-chart-1.xml and proves actual15/27 in same saved output. Final full light/dark rerun required, all4 pass.
failureHistory.extraReader: Independent post-App ZIP/XML active-chart→externalData→named-sheet reader initially treated package-absolute /xl/... target as relative and failed before data assertion; correct OPC package-root resolution now verifies5baseline/final sources with active cached and embedded values equal, exact dev/inode/mtime/ctime/SHA unchanged. SystemPython first-red and corrected raw output archived. No production/original App driver change or new formal count.
failureHistory.performanceBoundary: Observed real serial native layout adds tens of seconds to PPTX save/close checks. No end-to-end timing/performance pass or new production scheduler change claimed. Tests wait original receipts, do not bypass native rendering or cancel to manufacture speed.
